author: Life of Boris
description:
16 comrades, 16 tiny planes, 1000 potatoes. BORISTAN v0.3-beta "The Last Delivery" is out, and you can join my co-op room live on stream! 🚂✈️🥔

🎮 PLAY FREE (playtest until Sun 15 Nov, 20:00 EET): https://lifeofboris.itch.io/boristan Windows, Mac, Linux or straight in the browser. The download runs much better than the browser. 👥 Join the stream room: Esc → Co-op → Join and type the room code shown on stream. You need the newest 0.3-beta build.

✨ New since v0.2: 📦 The whole story, start to finish: forty crates to Babushka's door before Sunday 🗺️ A much bigger map: Borisgrad, Nyetsk, the Zone and a circle-line train ✈️ Tiny planes for everyone, glide all the way across town ☢️ The Zone: radiation, mist and a compass that has had a few 🏠 Your own flat, and the rent is always due 🫖 New minigames: samovar tea, potato tag, rug beating, a DJ battle and more 🗣️ Everyone babbles now, each in their own voice 🔫 Weapon wheel and better gamepad steering 🚀 Up to twice the fps on Windows and Linux,
title: 16 Comrades, 16 Tiny Planes, 1000 Potatoes✈️💥 | BORISTAN v0.3 co-op chaos
